title: Concurrent Counter
instructions: Implement `Counter`, `concurrent_inc` and `concurrent_dec` in `config/counter.py`. `Counter` holds a value guarded by a `threading.Lock`, with `incValue`, `decValue` and `getValue`. The two helpers call the matching method 1000 times, so many threads can hammer one counter without losing updates.

evidence.label: Returns the initial value and applies single-thread inc/dec
10 incrementing and 10 decrementing threads cancel out exactly
Mixed offsets from many threads give the exact arithmetic result
Loses no updates even when each update is slow
Does not use time.sleep to wait
